items.label: FIGURE 2.16
items.title: Effectively addressing inequality requires a comprehensive approach that tackles all phases of inequality
items.content: The diagram illustrates three phases of inequality and a cross-cutting strategy. 1. Inequality in building productive capacity: Invest in early life opportunities and human capital formation. 2. Inequality in utilizing productive capacity: Reduce market and institutional distortions that restrict access to markets and earning opportunities. 3. Inequality in taxes and transfers: Enhance fiscal redistribution that delivers long-term inclusive growth. A horizontal arrow spanning all three categories indicates the goal to 'Improve the productive capacity of the poor'. Source: World Bank.
